question: ‘Hola Mohalla festival’ started by Guru Gobind Singh Ji is majorly celebrated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hola Mohalla likewise called Hola,** is a three-day long Sikh celebration which ordinarily falls in Spring.
 
• It happens on the second day of the lunar month of Chett, a day after the Hindu spring celebration Holi[ however some of the time corresponds with Holi
